searchLog: Second consecutive day blocked (see 2026-09-04 entry this file replaces): every WebFetch call to an external domain returned EGRESS_BLOCKED, including job-board APIs (job-boards.greenhouse.io, jobs.ashbyhq.com, api.ashbyhq.com), company career pages (anthropic.com, databricks.com, notion.com, xai's greenhouse board), the program page for a time-sensitive candidate (matsprogram.org, MATS Winter 2027, Sept 6 fellowship deadline), and neutral controls (example.com, en.wikipedia.org, news.google.com) — only github.com/raw.githubusercontent.com resolved. Confirmed via a direct Bash curl through the session's own egress proxy that this is an org-level policy 403 ("connect_rejected"), not a WebFetch-tool quirk. WebSearch still works and surfaced live leads (MATS Winter 2027 applications open, deadline 2026-09-06 AoE; Databricks APM New Grad 2027; Scale AI Strategic Projects Lead New Grad), but hunt.md requires confirming eligibility/open-status/deadline from the actual page before including anything, which was impossible for all of them. Zero opportunities written rather than padding with unverified search snippets — this is a recurring network-policy failure blocking the hunt entirely, not an empty market. Flag for Dom: the egress policy for this cloud session needs a job-board allowlist (Greenhouse, Ashby, Workday, Lever, company career domains) or the hunt cannot function on any day.
